title.narrative: Democratic enlightenment for the Ukrainian youth

description.narrative: In our preparatory study, we found that the Ukrainian youth were in desperate need of a free and unbiased democratic education, as the media, state and school system have failed to provide this sufficiently. The Russian invasion has since changed the Ukrainian nation fundamentally and has made the need for an educated and resilient youth movement more incessant than ever. The conditions for this have changed drastically for the time being, but we remain convinced that, once the Ukrainian people regain their rightful independence and peace, LDLU will be an important player in rebuilding a hopeful, educated and nuanced understanding of democracy in the Ukrainian youth. We continue to believe that the best way for us to facilitate this is, in a digitalized post-war Ukraine, through member-developing seminars, focusing on democracy, human rights and advocacy. By doing so, we will help rebuild the organization from within by developing young members? knowledge and communication skills, as well as targeting the rest of the Ukrainian youth in an approachable and safe way through Youtube-videos.
